visual_identity.core_identity: A large ground-hunting wolf spider adapted for ambush rather than web-building, with a stockier hairy body and prominent forward-facing eyes.
visual_identity.silhouette: Low muscular spider body, sturdy eight legs, compact abdomen, flattened stalking posture.
visual_identity.head_features: Broad cephalothorax with several eyes including a prominent forward-facing pair, short powerful fangs.
visual_identity.body_shape: Stockier than a web spider, with thick jointed legs and compact abdomen built for sudden movement.
visual_identity.surface: Sparse coarse hair tufts on legs and body; no dense furry mass.

accuracy_checks: reads as hunting spider rather than web spider

reference.notes: Reference material controls creature identity, anatomy, and silhouette only; Black-Ink controls the final coloring-book rendering style.
